text: {"lessons":["Buying 100 shares of Stock D after a down period is a sizable bet; I should check that it fits my target allocation and investment case rather than averaging down automatically.","My account has grown overall, despite recent declines, so I should judge progress over a longer horizon instead of reacting to one month's return.","I should keep investing toward my apartment goal with a deliberate plan, balancing stocks and cash and making trades only when they support that plan."]}
